settings.ceo_bio:
DADO is more than porcelain stoneware — it is a combination of quality, design and trust. We approach every product with a focus on long-term value.

Our goal is to offer our customers not only beautiful, but also reliable and contemporary solutions. We continue to develop DADO with a strong commitment to quality and responsibility.
settings.ceo_bio_uz:
DADO — bu shunchaki keramogranit emas, bu sifat, dizayn va ishonch uyg‘unligidir. Biz har bir mahsulotga uzoq muddatli qiymat yaratish nuqtayi nazaridan yondashamiz.

Maqsadimiz — mijozlarimizga nafaqat chiroyli, balki ishonchli va zamonaviy yechimlarni taqdim etish. Biz DADO brendini sifat va mas’uliyat bilan rivojlantirishda davom etamiz.
settings.ceo_bio_ru:
DADO — это не просто керамогранит, а сочетание качества, дизайна и доверия. Мы подходим к каждому продукту с пониманием его долгосрочной ценности.

Наша цель — предлагать клиентам не только красивые, но и надёжные современные решения. Мы продолжаем развивать DADO, сохраняя высокие требования к качеству и ответственности.

brand.name: Crown
brand.subtitle: CERAMICS
brand.hero_subtitle: Collections that preserve the beauty of natural stone in porcelain stoneware.
brand.about_text:
CROWN collections draw on the classic motifs of Italian architecture: white and beige marble, warm travertine, soft limestone. Veins and colour transitions are reproduced with the naturalness of real stone, so the interior never feels heavy.

The brand offers a single colour system for floors and walls: within one collection, large-format porcelain stoneware, wall tile and decor elements are coordinated. This helps bring a project to a coherent finish.

history.title: The birth of the CROWN brand
history.text: DADO introduced a dedicated brand devoted to classic Italian style. The first collections consisted of 300×600 and 600×600 formats in white and beige marble looks.

history.title: Large format and polished surfaces
history.text: Polished porcelain stoneware in the 600×1200 format was added to the collections. This opened CROWN to wide use in hotel and public-interior projects.

history.title: Stone and decor line
history.text: The brand expanded with structured tiles in travertine and limestone looks and decorative wall tile with classic ornament. Floor, wall and decor can now be selected as one coordinated set within a collection.
